snippet.title: Squishies - Official Meta Quest Launch Trailer | Upload VR Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Squishies is available now on Meta Quest. Get another look at gameplay and the colorful world of Squishies in this trailer for the strategy, action-adventure game. Help the stranded Squishies find their way back home!
